$comment: Rules as data — roadmap 'Content as data'. Values come from spec.md §4 (stats, species, classes), §5 (creation points), §7.1 (steps), §8.1 (levels and tiers). Shape is packages/shared/src/types/domain.ts RulesContent; where this file and the docs disagree, the TS type wins. Icons are short slugs, never file paths: the client resolves them to inline SVG so every element has an icon (spec §11).

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.blurb: Gentle, stubborn, and impossible to scratch. Thorns lean away when a unicorn walks by.

passive.text: +1 Heart. You are the one everybody comes to when they are hurt.

worldAbility.name: Mend
worldAbility.text: Heal a small wound between fights, and walk through thorns and brambles without a scratch.

combatAction.name: Mending Light
combatAction.text: Touch a friend standing next to you. They get 3 HP back.

dragonling.name: Dragonling
dragonling.blurb: Small, warm, and much stronger than it looks. Wings still a little too big for it.

passive.text: +1 Might. Heavy things are just things.

worldAbility.name: Glide
worldAbility.text: Cross a gap, a chasm, or a river the party cannot walk around.

combatAction.name: Gliding Leap
combatAction.text: Sail over anything in your way and land on any open tile within 6 steps.

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.blurb: Half eagle, half lion, all opinions. Sees the whole map before anyone else does.

passive.text: +1 Quick. You are usually already there.

worldAbility.name: Skyward
worldAbility.text: Fly up and show the party the path ahead, with its hazards and its treasure.

combatAction.name: Sky Watch
combatAction.text: Circle overhead and call out where the enemies are going. Every friend gets +2 on their next roll.

bigfoot.name: Bigfoot
bigfoot.blurb: Enormous, shy, and very good at hugs. Doors are a suggestion.

passive.text: +2 max HP. There is simply more of you.

worldAbility.name: Smash
worldAbility.text: Break a barrier, lift something enormous, or carry a friend who cannot walk.

combatAction.name: Ground Smash
combatAction.text: Slam both hands down. Every enemy next to you is shoved back 2 steps.

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.blurb: A fox with too many tails and a plan for everything. Nobody is quite sure how many tails.

passive.text: +1 Clever. You notice the thing nobody else noticed.

worldAbility.name: Beguile
worldAbility.text: Charm someone into helping, or slip past a guard without being seen.

combatAction.name: Fox Fire
combatAction.text: Little blue flames dance around one enemy. It is so busy watching them that it skips its next turn.

manticore.name: Manticore
manticore.blurb: Lion, wings, and a curling tail. Grumpy in the morning, loyal all day.

passive.text: +1 Quick. Nothing is really out of reach.

worldAbility.name: Leap
worldAbility.text: Reach a high ledge, or drop down from any height and land just fine.

combatAction.name: Pounce
combatAction.text: Jump to any open tile within 6 steps and attack the moment you land.

thornguard.name: Thornguard
thornguard.blurb: You stand in front. That is the whole job, and it is a big one.

signature.name: Brace
signature.text: Take a hit that was meant for a friend standing next to you.

3.name: Shove
3.text: Push an enemy back 2 steps and step into its place.

6.name: Bramble Wall
6.text: Grow thorns on two tiles. Enemies have to go around.

9.name: Unbreakable
9.text: Until your next turn, you and every friend beside you take 1 less damage from every hit.

duskrunner.name: Duskrunner
duskrunner.blurb: Everywhere at once, never where the trouble lands.

signature.name: First Strike
signature.text: Go before anybody else on the first round.

3.name: Vanish
3.text: Slip out of sight. The next enemy that swings at you misses.

6.name: Twin Step
6.text: Move, attack, and then move again.

9.name: Storm of Blades
9.text: Attack two different enemies standing next to you.

starweaver.name: Starweaver
starweaver.blurb: You pull little pieces of the sky down and put them where they are needed.

signature.name: Burst
signature.text: Hit every enemy inside a 2x2 square of tiles.

3.name: Glimmer
3.text: A friend anywhere on the board gets +2 on their next roll.

6.name: Tanglelight
6.text: Ribbons of light wrap one enemy. It cannot move on its next turn.

9.name: Starfall
9.text: Every enemy on the board takes 2 damage. Once per fight.

songkeeper.name: Songkeeper
songkeeper.blurb: You keep everybody standing, and you make it look like a hero move. Because it is.

signature.name: Rally
signature.text: Heal a friend, or lift a knocked-down friend back up from across the board.

3.name: Soothe
3.text: A friend within 4 steps gets 3 HP back.

6.name: Chorus
6.text: Every friend gets 2 HP back and +1 on their next roll.

9.name: Encore
9.text: A friend takes another action right now. Once per fight.
